notes.AUS: 各州已經實施自願協助死亡；北領地 2026 年 8 月通過，是最後一個立法的地方，還沒生效
notes.CHE: 只准協助自殺：刑法第 115 條只處罰出於自私動機的協助自殺；病人要自己服藥，外國人也可以
notes.DEU: 只准協助自殺：2020 年 2 月聯邦憲法法院宣告禁止協助自殺服務的條文違憲；主動安樂死違法
notes.AUT: 只准協助自殺：《臨終意願法》（Sterbeverfügungsgesetz）2022 年 1 月 1 日生效；英文維基條目沒有寫，依法律
notes.USA: 只准協助自殺，依州而定：科羅拉多、奧勒岡、夏威夷、新墨西哥、華盛頓、佛蒙特、緬因、紐澤西、加州 9 州與華盛頓特區合法，蒙大拿事實上合法；主動安樂死全國違法
notes.TWN: 沒有合法化：病人自主權利法（2019 年施行）讓末期、不可逆昏迷、永久植物人、極重度失智等病人依預立醫療決定撤除或不施行維生治療；受囑託殺人與幫助自殺是刑法第 275 條的罪

notesEn.AUS: Voluntary assisted dying is in force in all states; the Northern Territory, the last place to legislate, passed it in August 2026, not yet in force
notesEn.CHE: Assisted suicide only: Art. 115 of the penal code punishes assisting suicide only for selfish motives; the patient takes the drug, and foreigners are eligible
notesEn.DEU: Assisted suicide only: in February 2020 the Federal Constitutional Court struck down the ban on assisted-suicide services; active euthanasia is illegal
notesEn.AUT: Assisted suicide only: the Dying Will Act (Sterbeverfügungsgesetz) took effect on 1 January 2022 (not in the Wikipedia article; from the statute)
notesEn.USA: Assisted suicide only, by state: legal in Colorado, Oregon, Hawaii, New Mexico, Washington, Vermont, Maine, New Jersey, California and DC, and de facto in Montana; active euthanasia is illegal nationwide
notesEn.TWN: Not legal: the Patient Right to Autonomy Act (in force since 2019) allows life-sustaining treatment to be withheld or withdrawn under an advance decision for terminal, irreversibly comatose, permanently vegetative or severely demented patients; killing on request and assisting suicide are crimes under Art. 275 of the Criminal Code
